hints.title: Zero Average Transformation
hints.text: Subtracting the overall average from every element shifts the target average to zero.

hints.title: Integer Scaling and Division
hints.text: Multiply all elements by n and subtract the total sum to perform all arithmetic with exact integers.

hints.title: Meet in the Middle Partitioning
hints.text: Split the zero-sum array into two halves of size up to fifteen. Generate all subset sums for each half and check if an opposite sum exists, excluding the empty and complete subsets.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Meet-in-the-middle on 15 elements with zero-average scaled integers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full subset generation 2^30 exceeds 10^9 operations and times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash sets hold at most 2^15 = 32768 integer sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Scale elements by n and subtract sum to avoid floating-point errors and simplify to subset sum zero.
